best_match.fbbt_definition: Adult uniglomerular antennal lobe projection neuron from the lateral neuroblast (ALl1) dorsal hemilineage with dendrites that mainly innervate antennal lobe glomerulus DL3 (Bates et al., 2020). The axons of these neurons innervate the lateral horn. There are around five of these per hemisphere, they fasciculate with the medial antennal lobe tract and they are cholinergic (Bates et al., 2020).
